name: ADC India Communications Limited
about: ADC India Communications Limited provides copper and fiber physical connectivity in telecommunications and data networking solutions in India and internationally. It operates through the Telecommunication and IT-Networking segments. The company offers structured cabling systems, such as copper and fiber cable, connectivity, and cable management solutions; copper and fiber products and services for public networks; and in-building and outdoor wireless systems. It also provides InterReach spectrum and fusion advanced multi-band in-building distributed antenna system; InterReach unison single-band in-building distributed antenna system; FlexWave prism DAS/Compact radio head; ClearGain cell site amplifiers tower and ground-mounted amplifiers; data center, fiber plug-and-play, and LAN solutions; and central office, FTTX and OSP, and data connectivity solutions. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Bengaluru, India. ADC India Communications Limited operates as a subsidiary of CommScope Connectivity LLC.
